response.sql:
WITH filtered_fees AS (
  SELECT f.feerate, f.rebrate, f.orderslink, o.dealedge
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT orderslink, dealedge,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM filtered_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge
),
side_averages AS (
  SELECT dealedge, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as side_avg
  FROM group_stats
  GROUP BY dealedge
)
SELECT gs.orderslink, gs.dealedge, gs.avg_net_fee_rate, gs.record_count,
  gs.avg_net_fee_rate - sa.side_avg as difference
FROM group_stats gs
INNER JOIN side_averages sa ON gs.dealedge = sa.dealedge
WHERE gs.avg_net_fee_rate > sa.side_avg
ORDER BY CASE WHEN (gs.avg_net_fee_rate - sa.side_avg) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  (gs.avg_net_fee_rate - sa.side_avg) DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "the number of records" in each (orderslink, dealedge) group refers to all records in that group (COUNT(*)), while "ignoring missing values" applies only to the average net fee rate calculation (AVG(feerate - rebrate)), where NULL values in the subtraction are automatically excluded from the average but the records themselves are still counted.

alternatives.interpretation: "the number of records" refers only to records that contribute to the average (i.e., records with both feerate and rebrate non-NULL), not all records in the group.
alternatives.sql:
WITH filtered_fees AS (
  SELECT f.feerate, f.rebrate, f.orderslink, o.dealedge
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT orderslink, dealedge,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN feerate IS NOT NULL AND rebrate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as record_count
  FROM filtered_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge
),
side_averages AS (
  SELECT dealedge, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as side_avg
  FROM group_stats
  GROUP BY dealedge
)
SELECT gs.orderslink, gs.dealedge, gs.avg_net_fee_rate, gs.record_count,
  gs.avg_net_fee_rate - sa.side_avg as difference
FROM group_stats gs
INNER JOIN side_averages sa ON gs.dealedge = sa.dealedge
WHERE gs.avg_net_fee_rate > sa.side_avg
ORDER BY CASE WHEN (gs.avg_net_fee_rate - sa.side_avg) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  (gs.avg_net_fee_rate - sa.side_avg) DESC
LIMIT 10;
